pages.text: $(bold)Placeable Food$()$(br2)Some dishes can be placed in the world as decorations or for sharing.$(br2)$(bold)Types:$()$(br)• $(item)Plated Dishes$(): Place on blocks$(br)• $(item)Bowled Soups$(): Placeable soup containers$(br)• $(item)Cakes$(): Multi-layer edible cakes$(br2)Sneak-right-click to place, right-click to eat.

$(bold)Multiplayer Sharing$()$(br2)Placed food can be consumed by other players, perfect for:$(br2)• Multiplayer dining parties$(br)• Base decoration$(br)• Food displays$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Different foods have different serving counts and restoration effects!

$(bold)Royal Naval Salted Beef$()$(br2)Sneak and use the beef on top of a block to set it down. Use an empty bowl on the barrel to take one plated serving. A full barrel holds two servings; eating one leaves just one to take away.$(br2)$(bold)He Wei Dao$()$(br2)Some wandering traders offer one cup for 8 emeralds, up to 3 times.
